versions.text: Special devices using aerodynamic surfaces (such as slats and spoilers) or structure whose failure conditions would cause Hazardous or more serious failure condition effect, must be designed for the loads to which they are subjected. These loads must be determined from test data or using proven or acceptable design procedures.
